notes: A single 18650 Li-ion cell (3.0-4.2 V, protected or bare). The holder is not polarized: the cell's orientation decides which contact is +. Print + and - on the silkscreen beside the holder (Keystone marks its base) and wire the + contact to VBAT, the other to GND.
Feed the cell through a protection circuit (DW01A + FS8205A) unless the cell has its own, and charge it with TP4056, MCP73831, BQ24074 or IP5306.
The courtyard covers the whole cell (77.1 x 20.7 mm): nothing tall under or beside it.
The pad layout gives minimum pad sizes and the minimum length over the pads; the locating holes are non-plated.
